full_query: On the losartan can I take two pills at once or at separate times?
sentences: Losartan is an angiotensin II receptor antagonist used to treat high blood pressure and certain types of kidney disease
The recommended dosage of losartan is typically 50-100 mg once daily
Taking two pills at once is not recommended, as it may increase the risk of adverse effects and does not provide additional benefits
Instead, it is best to take losartan at the same time every day, as directed by your healthcare provider
